intro.title: 5 Mukhi Rudraksha Mala

When worn it helps the wearer to connect with his/her real self that paves the path to clearing stubborn blockages and forgive and forget. Also helps to increase awareness and understanding, sharpen the intellect, gain wisdom, creativity and get relief from the malefic effects of Planet Guru. This Mala is widely used for Japa (chanting mantras).
